requirements.requirement: Identify the article published in November 2019 by a media company founded in the 1960s, where the article discusses different scoring methods for various types of the same sport.
Determine the only professional athlete referenced by name throughout the entire November 2019 article.
Identify the article published in January 2020 by a media company that originated in the 1950s, where the article is about the athlete identified from the November 2019 article.
Establish that the January 2020 article has excerpts from an interview the athlete had done.
Determine the hometown of that athlete according to the January 2020 article.
